title: deep_research.requested (v1)
description: ResearchOrchestrator instructs DeepResearchAgent to begin literature / field-trajectory research. A method-targeted pass carries the frozen method and may carry a prior audit when closing a known evidence gap.

research_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen ResearchSpec object.

method_ref.description: Optional frozen Method ref for an exact targeted novelty search.

novelty_audit_report_ref.description: Optional frozen NoveltyAuditReport ref identifying the evidence gaps to resolve.

targeted_search_id.description: Correlation identity for one targeted search of the frozen method.
